features.note: The Display panel's font row steps through the families of BifrOSt's font library, System Font first. EPUB pages are measured and drawn in the chosen face, so the pagination changes with it; chrome stays in the system face. The row is disabled for a PDF, whose pages keep the font the document sets, and a footnote says so. Tested headless in books/store_prefs_tests.rs (the_family_row_steps_through_the_system_face_and_the_library, the_family_choice_is_off_for_pdfs), books/layout.rs (the_measure_of_the_chosen_face_sets_the_page_count) and books/settings_wiring_tests.rs (the_font_row_changes_an_epub_and_leaves_a_pdf_alone). Gap: the row steps through the families rather than showing a list; the faces come from the font library only, not the system's fonts; not verified on Midget.
features.wire: Verify on Midget that a library family changes EPUB line breaks and that the row is dimmed with its footnote for a PDF; replace the stepper with a list of families when the Display panel has room.

features.note: Books > Settings (Cmd+,) opens a Settings window. General lists the library folders: the built-in ones, and user folders added with Add Folder and removed with Remove; Open Books In chooses single page or continuous scroll for a book's first opening.
